findings.reason: the field list must be corrected to the pointer's real keys or the node's whole gate is unsatisfiable as written.
findings.text: §29's Deliverable requires the discard record to keep each of held, hold_detail and failure_detail "that the pointer carries", but none of the three is a field of a queued pointer — they are keys of the dict admit_once returns (reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:791, :831, :906); the pointer instead carries hold (reckon/crew/dispatch.py:264, whose dict has a nested held key) and failure (reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:628-637), and the done-when "finds each of those fields in the spool record with the pointer's value" cannot pass for a field the pointer does not carry, so the builder either stops or silently drops the requirement

findings.reason: the verdict set must gain the retry-back-off case, or the log is silent for the very wait the section exists to make readable.
findings.text: §30 enumerates the per-pass verdict as "launched, held for allowance, held by the gate, held behind an earlier request, or refused", but the admission pass also holds a queued request on its retry back-off (_retry_backoff_hold, reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:576-616, reached at :837), and its Why lists "held for its session's allowance, held by the gate, held behind an earlier request, or never considered" with the same omission; that back-off wait is exactly the state §28 is about ("It does not wait out its backoff of up to 600 s", :185), so a request sitting in back-off — the case §25 needs explained — would write no line under the enumerated verdicts, and the done-when exercises only held-for-allowance then launched so it cannot catch the gap

findings.reason: the Why's substantive point that the admission fields are absent is correct, so only the field name needs a one-word correction.
findings.text: §29's Why says the discard record "carries only phase, node, pointer_path and discarded_run_id", but the record _write_discard_record writes (reckon/crew/promotion.py:1536-1557) and the actual spool file it cites (~/.config/reckon/crew/discards/r-20261018T085353346020-review-of-the-inventory-lists-the-reload-tree-publish-9abe3b66c30c.json) carry run_id, discarded_at, phase, node and pointer_path — there is no discarded_run_id anywhere in the tree, and the omitted discarded_at is the 12:40:57Z time the same sentence relies on

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: a finding — §29's Why names a discard-record field that does not exist.
